title: These were recommended by my Podiatrist
description: These were recommended by my Podiatrist Relieved my Plantar Fascitis for 3 Days. Then the unbearable pain returned in full force. These were recommended by my Podiatrist. Not the same as all my other pairs. This is my 6th pair and they are the best thing ever for my plantar fasciitis and resultant neuromas. Unfortunately, the ones I ordered from SmartDestination must be seconds as they kill my feet. The hard plastic insert rubs on the outside edges of my feet. I am unable to exchange them as I waited one day too late to use them in my walking shoes. Great inserts We have used these inserts for years.  They provide great support. Personal favorite Pinnacle seems to have more cushioning so my husband likes them better. He's tried all the other Powerstep inserts as well as other brands. This is his must have insert. He is 6'3" and weighs 257lbs with bone spurs (plantar fasciitis) and a high instep. He is very active and wears these in all his shoes. His bone spurs rarely bother him any more. Remember to replace them every 3 months if you wear them every day, especially if you weigh more than average and/or run. Five Stars Excellent insole with good support. Great comfort! A little more cushion than the Powerstep Protech but the arch is maybe just a little lower. We love both styles. Excellent for plantar fasciitis and neuromas. These insoles help my heel feels much better. I would never wear a pair of athletic ... These insoles help my heels feel much better.  I would never wear a pair of athletic shoes with the original insoles.
